title: Group Chat and Semester
author: Yara Reyes
blurb: Marguerite Ashgrove, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before the final audition.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
